about: The eGFR on 5 August 2025 preceded the start of empagliflozin for type 2 diabetes on 8 August 2025, and more than a year of treatment had passed without a repeat eGFR by the final supply on 25 October 2026.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about eGFR during more than a year of empagliflozin supplies, and the directions do not state why it was supplied.
The last recorded eGFR is exactly one year before the latest empagliflozin supply and meets the annual interval.
